name: opt-in-mcp-watch-v1
prerequisite: incremental-update-validation.json: 113/113 complete-record equality; CI and four-platform builds passed before implementation
query_timeout: existing MCP tool timeout, including waiting for a clean generation and retries
generation_contract: One cached builder owner; private candidates, full project resolution with cached clean extraction.
Use shared graph-query handlers and existing schemas, argument validation, licensing, and formatting.
Normalize dirty paths; paired renames remove old and create new. Unknown rename, directory removal, overflow, ownership ambiguity, unstable reads require full reconciliation.
Check mtime and size twice, 100 ms apart, and validate the owned source/configuration state around reads and publication.
Do not publish partial candidates. Journal and atomically replace persistence before publishing the generation.
Graph-dependent calls wait while stale, within their existing timeout. An invalidated generation cannot emit paid results; retry or return an explicit tool error.
Hold a graph-owner OS lock outside the watched root, reject another owner of the same graph, and coordinate persistence with all existing graph writers.
Honor source configuration and hard exclusions target, .git, node_modules, __pycache__. Ignore own persistence traffic.
Preserve cold-analysis misses; no claims of improved semantic coverage.

measurement.latency_scope: Include event coalescing, stability checks, filesystem inventory, cache cloning, resolution, journal persistence, and publication. Report initial construction separately.
measurement.assessment: Any cold-equivalence mismatch, stale paid response, or failed required gate fails correctness regardless of latency. Preserve failures and corrective records separately.
measurement.limitations: Report frequent full parsing as a delivery limitation even if correctness passes. Synthetic tests do not establish production latency or improved semantic coverage.
